title: feat: 10 new in-app notifications (A–J) + 1-page contract print CSS
body:
## Summary

Adds all 10 missing in-app notification types (A–J) to the existing Firestore-backed bell. **In-app only — no email infrastructure**, per request.

| # | Type | Recipient | Trigger |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | `advance_received` | client | Admin clicks **Confirm advance** (`markAdvancePaid`) |
| B | `deliverable_accepted` | creator | Client clicks **Accept delivery** (new `acceptDelivery`) |
| C | `deliverable_revisions` | creator | Client clicks **Request revisions** w/ note (new `requestRevisions`) |
| D | `payment_released` | creator | Admin clicks **Release payment** (new `releasePayment`) |
| E | `deadline_approaching` | client + creator | Portal-mount hook, fires when `deliveryDeadline − now ≤ 24 h` (idempotent via `bid.deadlineNotifiedAt`) |
| F | `offer_expired` | client | Portal-mount hook, `status==="open"` & no bids & `now − createdAt > 14 d` (idempotent via `offer.expiredNotifiedAt`) |
| G | `new_creator_signup` | admin | New creator application (`addCreator`) |
| H | `rating_reminder` | both | Portal-mount hook, fires 24 h after `deliveryAcceptedAt` (idempotent via `bid.ratingPromptedAt`) |
| I | `bundle_milestone` | client | Hooked into `updateDeliverable` — fires at the 3rd / 5th / 10th / 25th / 50th / 100th delivered (idempotent via `subscription.lastMilestoneNotified`) |
| J | `contract_ready` | both | Auto-fired after the advance is confirmed (`markAdvancePaid`) |

### New UI bits
- **Client portal**: Accept delivery / Request revisions buttons + inline revision-note field on delivered bids.
- **Creator portal**: revision-note banner + payout state on accepted bids.
- **Admin portal**: Bids tab now has an **Awaiting payout** section with a **Release payment** button on accepted bids whose delivery the client already approved.

### Bonus: 1-page contract print CSS
Tightens `Contract.tsx` `@media print` so the contract fits on a single A4 sheet instead of spilling to a 2nd page (the issue we noticed during PR #36 testing). Reduced page margins, smaller print font, `page-break-inside: avoid` on key cards so the signature block can't orphan.

### What didn't change
- Email: still zero. (User explicitly: *"in the app only, only in website"*.)
- 13 existing notification types — fully untouched.
- Firestore security rules — no changes; `bids` and `offers` already allow authed updates, which covers the new fields.

## Review & Testing Checklist for Human

- [ ] Open the bell as **admin**, **client**, **creator** in turn — confirm new notifications appear with the right localized AR/FR/EN copy and click-through to the right portal page.
- [ ] **A + J:** as admin, click *Confirm advance* on a client offer → client should get two notifications (`advance_received` + `contract_ready`); creator should get two as well (`advance_paid` + `contract_ready`). Click `contract_ready` → opens `/contract/<id>/<role>`.
- [ ] **B + C + D:** as creator, submit a deliverable → as client, hit *Accept delivery* (creator gets `deliverable_accepted`) **OR** *Request revisions* with a note (creator gets `deliverable_revisions` w/ note in body, bid status reverts so they can re-submit). After accept, as admin → Bids tab → *Awaiting payout* shows the bid → click *Release payment* → creator gets `payment_released`.
- [ ] **G:** sign up a new creator (form path) → admin's bell shows `new_creator_signup`.
- [ ] **E / F / H:** harder to test live — these fire automatically on portal mount when the time threshold is reached. Sanity-check by manually editing a bid's `deliveryDeadline` to `now + 12h` in Firestore, refresh the portal, and check the bell.
- [ ] **I:** mark 3 bundle deliverables as `delivered` (admin → Bundles → deliverables) → client gets `bundle_milestone` once.
- [ ] Print the contract (any role) → confirm it fits on **a single A4 page** in Chrome's print preview.
- [ ] Confirm none of the existing 13 notifications regressed (post a project, place a bid, accept a bid, etc. should still notify exactly as before).

### Notes
- **Idempotency**: each time-based check writes a flag on the source doc (`deadlineNotifiedAt`, `expiredNotifiedAt`, `ratingPromptedAt`, `lastMilestoneNotified`). Re-mounting the portal is safe — same event will not double-fire.
- **No new Firestore collections** — everything piggybacks on existing `notifications`, `offers`, `bids`, `bundleSubscriptions`. Free-tier safe.
- **Lint / typecheck**: 0 new lint errors over `main`'s baseline (36 problems on both). `tsc --noEmit` clean. `vite build` succeeds.
- The bundle-milestone trigger is intentionally conservative (3 / 5 / 10 / 25 / 50 / 100). If you want different thresholds, change the `milestones` array in `bundles.ts`.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/0b927942aef54f55bff48dae6bffbb43
